input: Get a flu shot before the season starts

gold.taskTitle: Get a Flu Shot Before Season Starts
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to get a flu shot in time before flu season begins.

questions.title: What is your target deadline to get the shot?
questions.description: Identify the specific date or timeframe the user considers 'before the season starts'.

questions.title: Do you have a doctor or clinic already in mind?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has a preferred provider or needs help finding one.

questions.title: Does your insurance cover the flu shot cost?
questions.description: Clarify whether cost or insurance coverage is a factor in choosing where to go.

questions.title: Do you need a specific flu shot formulation?
questions.description: Check if the user requires a specific type, such as high-dose for seniors or egg-free.

questions.title: Have you had any past reactions to flu vaccines?
questions.description: Identify any medical considerations or allergies that could affect the plan.

questions.title: Do you prefer a walk-in location or a scheduled appointment?
questions.description: Understand the user's preference for how they want to book the shot.

questions.title: Are you getting this shot alongside anyone else?
questions.description: Determine if the user is coordinating this for family members or just themselves.
